title: Last Bus to Halden
concept: On the last bus home, each stop's passengers are people from a woman's past — in reverse order of when she last saw them.
conflict: She needs to get off; the bell doesn't work.
escalation: Her childhood best friend boards, then her late father, then — her as a child.
reveal: The bus runs backwards through her life to the night she was supposed to be on it — the night it crashed.
ending: Amara pulls the bell. It works. She steps off into 1998, and the bus drives away with her younger self waving.

hooks.line: On the last bus home, my dad got on. He died six years ago.
hooks.first_visual: Bus doors fold open; a silhouette.

hooks.line: Every stop, someone I used to know gets on. In reverse order.
On the last bus, you don't ring the bell until it's your stop. You'll know.
Where does the last bus actually go?
The little girl at the back has my face.
hooks.first_visual: A child in a yellow raincoat.
